title: Shutoffs near us; our power still on
text:
⚡ Power shutoffs near us — ours still on
SCE has shut off power on 14 circuits near us: Guitar (under 1 mi west), Tuba (~2 mi north-northwest), Bouquet (~3 mi east), Neargate (~5 mi south-southeast) and 10 more. Our circuit (Orion) was still on at 12:02 AM, and SCE lists it for a possible shutoff until Fri 9 PM.
Charge phones and batteries now, and know how to open your garage door by hand.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
